text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

The panel's composition isn't evidence of anything here. Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex can't easily explain a preference between you — and an all-women panel is just as consistent with a workplace where women are well represented in senior roles. Raising it would likely read as grasping, and could undermine your more substantial points.

What's actually worth pursuing: the unanswered request for written reasons. Send a short, firm follow-up with a deadline. If age is your real concern — you're in your forties, she has roughly half your experience and was assessed on "client relationships" — that's a different and more arguable issue, but you'd need more than this to go on.
